container: ephemeral; network none; read-only root and source; private tmpfs; evidence mount only writable
hypothesis: The optimized-mode XRes supervision timeout observed once in R02 is scheduling-sensitive under this container; repeated frozen attempts will show whether the 150 ms XRes query budget produces intermittent UNKNOWN or stable behavior.
decision_rule: For each attempt retain unittest outcome and XRes disconnect status. A task result is acceptable only if the test and independent task oracle both pass, release readback is neutral, no extra old-task effect occurs, and late horizon is clean. An XRes supervision timeout remains UNKNOWN and a task oracle failure remains failure even if cleanup/test assertions pass.
limits: Three repeated synthetic Xvfb attempts are diagnostic samples, not a reliability rate or production guarantee.
